verdict.rationale: OpenRouter lets users limit retention exposure by restricting requests, per request or account-wide, to providers with specific data policies. It also offers an account setting to block providers that may train on your data. A community user confirms a global 'ZDR-only' toggle, and the providers page lists per-provider retention. However, nothing in the pack shows users deleting stored prompts, completions or logs, or configuring OpenRouter's own retention periods; the 'no true guarantees of ZDR' comment is skepticism rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: user-initiated deletion of stored data/logs, configurable retention windows for OpenRouter's own storage, independent verification that retention controls are enforced.
